description: Chart report widget, bound via flow_id/flow_type/report_id.
notes: Beyond the flow/report trio, a live report/chart carries showHeader (boolean, false in the capture) and filterParameters — whose Property is Type:"FilterParam" (NOT the usual Type:"Value") with Value:null. These are display config, not binding, so they are NOT mirrored into Component.Data; only the flow_type/flow_id/report_id trio is double-encoded there (same convention widget_metrics/widget_general_masterdetail prove).
ALL report/* widgets bind via the flow_id/flow_type/report_id trio (report_id instead of view_id — the one difference from the view/* binding trio).

Data.report_type on the Component itself is "ChartReport" for this widget, distinct from Data.visualization_type — both are written, and both matter (report_type selects the report DEFINITION kind; visualization_type selects the widget's own render mode).

A report widget re-renders ANY report definition it is bound to in its OWN visualization (unlike view/* widgets, which are constrained by the bound view's type) — card/pivot report widgets specifically need a matching report_type to already exist on the flow, or the bind has nothing compatible to show.

A freshly created flow report gets ZERO members just like a freshly created process — Permissions:[] on the report renders "You don't have access to this component" inside any page that charts it, fixed the same way as a process (POST .../report/{rid}/member/batch).

Real ids typically use the manifest_id prefix only on a fresh single-widget add (e.g. `Button_<10-char-rand>`, `Metrics_<10-char-rand>`) — the scenario this template mints for — while built-up production pages (`all_pages_draft_20260806.json`) mostly carry the generic `Component_<rand>` id instead, and Repeater/Tab/MasterDetail/Breadcrumbs were never observed prefixed at all.
